How Party Photo Sharing Works on NextVibe

  1. 1

    Create your event

    Set up your party on NextVibe in under two minutes. Add the date, venue, and a cover photo.

  2. 2

    Share the QR code

    NextVibe generates a unique QR code and VibeTag for your event. Print it, text it, or display it on screens at the venue.

  3. 3

    Guests upload instantly

    Guests scan the QR code with their phone camera and upload photos and videos directly to your shared album — no app download required for basic sharing.

  4. 4

    Everything in one place

    All photos are automatically organised by event. Browse, download, and share the full album after the party ends.

Frequently Asked Questions

Do guests need to download an app to share photos?
No. Guests scan the QR code with their phone's native camera and are taken directly to the shared album in their mobile browser. No app download is required for uploading photos to the shared party album.
How many photos can guests upload?
NextVibe is designed to handle high-volume events. Guests can upload photos and short videos throughout the event with no per-guest limits on the shared album.
Can I download all the photos after the party?
Yes. The event organiser can download all photos and videos from the shared album in full resolution after the event. Guests can also download individual photos they want to keep.
How is NextVibe different from a Google Photos shared album?
Google Photos requires all guests to have a Google account and manually accept a sharing invite. NextVibe works via QR code — any guest can join instantly. You also get event-specific features like VibeTags, games, RSVP management, and digital postcards that don't exist in Google Photos.
